name: shader-toy
blurb: GLSL shader rendered live on canvas, fully customizable by code.
description: Wraps a WebGL canvas rendering custom GLSL fragment shaders; passes uniforms (time, resolution, mouse) to animate effects.
use_when: Unique generative or algorithmic visuals requiring low-level GPU control.
avoid_when: Browsers without WebGL; complex shaders may cause performance issues on lower-end devices.
a11y: Decorative visual only. No keyboard or focus handling.
